objective: Identify all archived payment records that are fraudulent according to the fraud criteria in the payments/3DS policy, and cite each record's path.

params.fraud_identification_method: Discover distinct payment_status and three_ds_status for archived payments (is_archived_basket_reference=1), then read /docs/payments/3ds.md for criteria that flag a payment as fraudulent, and select rows matching those criteria. Apply customer-ownership filter only if requester is a customer (here guest, so no filter).
